page.overview:
What is Hydronauts?

Hydronauts (called Aquanauts outside of America, just like the 1995 subtheme) are a Aquazone subtheme introduced in 1998.

The Hydronauts subtheme's bright yellow colour scheme was similar the one of the earlier Aquanauts line; the only differences are the transparent pieces which are now exclusively transparent green instead of blue and fluorescent reddish orange. The minifigs have unique masks printed onto their faces which gave them a very alien look. The Hydronauts use suction cups to move their storage boxes in contrast to the commonly utilised magnets.

The Hydronauts are a heroic faction, continuing the role of their predecessor Aquanauts. With a dwindling supply of hydrolator crystals remaining in the Aquazone, the Hydronauts have the technology to search for more crystals in the zone's deepest depths. Their enemies are the Stingrays, who were once related to the Hydronauts.

There's trouble in the Aquazone...the oxygen giving hydrolator crystals are running out! Only the Hydronauts have the high tech tools and ships to discover a new supply. But an evil Stingray Squad will do anything to prevent the Hydronauts from getting at the crystals. Who will capture all the crystals and rule the Aquazone? Only time and YOU can tell...
